If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the systemic barriers that perpetuate inequality—whether based on race, gender, socioeconomic status, or geography—so that every person has equitable access to education, healthcare, and opportunity. True progress happens when we remove the obstacles that hold people back, allowing them to contribute their full potential to society.
